rule: Ask your bank for the freeze details: the police station, the case or FIR number, the date of the request, and the legal sections used.

The Kerala High Court has said banks should hold only the disputed amount and not freeze the whole account. It gave this ruling in Dr Sajeer v RBI (judgments of 25 Sept and 6 Oct 2023) and repeated it in later cases.
source: Kerala High Court judgments in Dr Sajeer v RBI as reported by Onmanorama on 19 Oct 2023

rule: MHA SOP dated 02.01.2026 (Clause 10 on page 36); modules live April 2026 per an MHA statement reported by DNA India.
Supreme Court order (of 4 Aug 2026 as reported by LiveLaw) said people whose accounts are frozen should first use the official grievance redressal mechanism.
source: On 4 August 2026 the Supreme Court told all States and police to start using the grievance redressal and money restoration modules. It also told the RBI to frame a bank SOP within four weeks.

rule: If you were scammed, report it immediately on the National Cybercrime Helpline 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in.

If you let someone else use your account or UPI you may need a lawyer. Call the NALSA helpline 15100 to ask if you qualify for free legal aid. Eligibility depends on your category or income (for example women or SC and ST members or people under a state income limit). Do not claim you are innocent.
Wapas will never ask for money, OTPs, PINs or passwords.
